parse_spark_standalone_results: parse Spark Standalone benchmark results from stdout to extract execution time, queries per hour, and IOPS metrics
extract_execution_time: extract test execution time metrics from Spark Standalone results by parsing test-release_test lines
extract_queries_per_hour: extract queries per hour and compute normalized score against the Spark benchmark baseline
extract_worker_resources: extract worker cores and worker memory configuration from Spark Standalone benchmark output
extract_iops_metrics: extract total IOPS read and write metrics from Spark Standalone benchmark results
